title: Fitness plan, AI steers
spec: User gives a vague goal. AI sets each next step and the user goes along with short answers. AI provides the ideas and the plan.

messages.content: Happy to help! Let's start with a simple structure: three strength sessions a week plus daily walks, since that combination gives the biggest return for beginners. First, let's set up your weekly schedule. Which days could you train for about 45 minutes?

Great. Here's your plan:

Monday: squats, push-ups, rows (3x10)
Wednesday: deadlifts with a light kettlebell, lunges, plank
Friday: repeat Monday with one more set
Every day: 30-minute walk

Next, let's look at nutrition. I suggest aiming for protein at every meal, around 1.6 g per kg of body weight. Shall I build a simple meal template?

Here's the template: breakfast with eggs or Greek yoghurt, lunch with chicken or beans plus vegetables, dinner with fish or tofu, and a snack of cottage cheese or nuts. Next week we'll add progression: increase the weight when 3x10 feels easy. Let's also track your workouts in a simple note so we can adjust.
Perfect. Start on Monday and tell me how the first session felt.
